Run the Word Factori Client from the Archipelago Launcher and connect to your slot.
Received items unlock machine families, word lengths, and level packs.
After receiving an unlock, return to the slot menu and reselect this mod so Word Factori reloads levels.json.
The client reads completed level indices from the active save and never writes the save.
Only this mod's levels.json is rewritten by the client.
The game executable, data.win, vanilla levels, recipes, and save data are never patched.
Use /wf_status in the client to inspect bridge state.
Use /wf_scan for an explicit one-time save scan if automatic mod-selection detection is unavailable.
If a game update changes the save format, use /wf_complete followed by a level number, target word, or full location name.
